source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I've never participated in a study like this before, so I don't know exactly how it will go.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Although I usually play all game genres, I like FPS games the most.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I don't know exactly what attracts me to these types of games, but I've been into FPS games since I was little.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I like the competitive spirit of this game genre and what people can do against each other. It's nice to see your own progress day by day, month by month. These are the things that attract me in general.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Of course, I also played MMORPGs like World of Warcraft. I also played Lost and Dark, which is famous recently. I love this game genre.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I don't like grind in RPG games. I find PVP is deficient in RPG games. RPG games are usually PVE focused, in the game we are fighting bots etc.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Definitely, I think that also reduces competitiveness.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I saw Counter-Strike: Global Offensive from one of my friends when I was very young, I played it for a very long time. Lately, I've been playing Valorant.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I've played Warzone, I've played Overwatch, I can say I've played all the PFS games on the market.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: What exactly do you mean by style?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: When I play, I don't make sudden decisions and play games aggressively, I usually play strategically, I also help with my support. I didn't understand much when I was younger, I didn't have such a certain style, as I grew up, as time passed, as I understood the rank systems in the games and learned what I needed to do, I turned into a more technical and supportive player.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Ranking games especially attract me. I do not prefer games that are played just to pass time for fun. I play such games only if my friends insist, but I never spare time for such games by myself. Competitive games are always my first choice.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Regardless of the game type, it can be Moba, it can be PRG, if there is any rank system, it is a pleasure for me to try to go up in that rank system.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I can say I'm good at aiming. I definitely think I'm a lot better than the average player.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I am not interested in mobile games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I have played PUBGM but I didn't spend much time.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I only use two fingers I use my thumbs.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: You can use other fingers when needed. Sometimes I also use my index fingers. But generally I only use 2 fingers.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I mostly get information from social media platforms. Especially from pages on Twitch and Twitter. I'll try if I see a new game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I follow the pages that share the upcoming e-sports games on Twitter. wtcN (Twitch streamer) plays the upcoming games on Twitch, and I watch it too.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I think the most important ones are weapon mechanics and aim mechanics. Map design is also very important. If there is any character in the game, the character's skills are important. Character abilities are very important. This is the order of importance for me. The most important of course is the weapon mechanics.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: It definitely motivates me, I would definitely like to try the game if it was created by adding an extra feature on top of the games on the market right now.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: If the next game is of the best quality available, I might want to try it. But right now, newly produced games are usually worse.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Escape from Tarkov, I've heard of this game, watched its videos, but I haven't played it because it's too expensive in Turkey. I play Warzone 2.0 DMZ.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I have no idea about the rest. I've heard of their names but never watched their videos or anything.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Hunt: Showdown and Dark and Darker.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Of course I've heard of Pubg, but I haven't heard of the others.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Tarkov is a more realistic game, they copied real life, DMZ is a more gun-based, less realistic game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I came across the game on a broadcast 2-3 years ago, my friends told me, we thought of playing it later, but we didn't play it because it was too expensive.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Yes, the price was the only reason we didn't play, we liked the game so much.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: The type of game we call PVPVE. A realistic simulation game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I have no idea, do I have to make up a name?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I think PVPVE is something that is used. At least I think people who know about this game are familiar with the term.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I describe as losing loot when you die, because we actually lose loot when we die.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: When DMZ first came out, I thought it was a game inspired by Tarkov. Landing on a map, doing quests, losing loot when you die, being able to take loot out of the game, I think these are all similar. Weapon mechanics are not very similar, but they all have their own good sides. The loot mechanics of the two games are similar.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: It is very difficult to make comparisons between the two groups. Sometimes it's very enjoyable to play one, sometimes the other.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: The fun of the two is very different, we survive for a long time in one, while we play the other as rounds.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: First of all, I think that realism and weapon mechanism are the most important thing in this kind of games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I think the weapon mechanism in FPS games is the most important thing because what a player first experiences weapon mechanisms. Secondly, the tasks of the game, the goal that the game gives you, the existence of a goal in the game is very important. Thirdly, the loot and items in the game are important.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I think Tarkov is close to these two games, but I think Tarkov is more fun.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Because it has a more extreme perception of reality.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Even the weapon usage in the game is very close to the real life weapon usage. But Arma is not like that, it still gives the feeling of a game. It's much more realistic in Tarkov, and being so close to reality draws people to the game, it drew me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Of course this is a bonus. In the game, we even waste time opening someone's bag. Realism draws people and me to the game. Because Tarkov offers players a different experience than the games on the market.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: My friends like this type of games. As I said, Escape From Tarkov offers much different things compared to the games on the market, which attracts people to the game, so everyone wants to try the game. I have never heard a bad comment about this game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Tarkov. Because it is a game that is open to development compared to DMZ mode. DMZ is a game mod and it has a lot of bugs because it's new.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I played previous versions of Call of duty, this was a new version, my friends were also playing this game, it drew me. As I played, I realized that it was a lot of fun not to have a different style to a weapon mechanic that I am used to.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: When I first heard that the game was coming out, I expected it to be like Tarkov, I had already heard that the game was inspired by Tarkov. But I couldn't see the details and depth in Tarkov in this game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: No, I didn't have any problems. Since it is a mod integrated into the game, we entered and played the game when it came out.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I played 20-30 hours total.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: 3-4 hours a week or 5-6 hours depending on my mood sometimes I play less, sometimes I play more.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: We usually play 2 days a week, we play around 2 hours at a time.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: 5.5 I think there is very little variety in the game and the game needs to be improved.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: 8. Although I haven't played the game much, I don't think a mobile game can be made better than this. It's harder to make good games on mobile…

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: 8. I think the game is very detailed, high quality and very enjoyable, even though I haven't played the game yet, I enjoyed watching it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: The features that distinguish the game from Valorant and Counter Strike are weapon mechanics and movement mechanisms. Being a Battle Royale, Warzone is different, DMZ is different, we can't get anything from other FPS, we get very different things from it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: More arcade of weapons and gameplay. Other FPS games I've played are more tactical. But Warzone isn't like that, it's more of a game open to action and fun. Apart from these, there is a loot system. You have tasks to do. There is a large map. Nice stuff inside the map. Better quality graphics.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: These are the most important features, without them I wouldn't play the game. Especially weapons and gameplay are very important to me. How the characters are managed in the game, the movements that can be made in the game, the movements of the characters such as flying and so on are very important.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Killing different players within the game. Because I'm competitive.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: The main purpose of the game is to kill people and to fight different people gives me great pleasure. The game's PVP especially.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: When I think about it, I can't think of anything. Like I said, weapons... I feel like I'm repeating the same things over and over.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Are you asking for general games or for DMZ?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: DMZ became more enjoyable as I learned the game. But I can't say that there is a big difference between.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I can say this for all games, the more I learn, the more I enjoy it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: These two game genres are very different from each other.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: First of all, we can attach something to the weapon in Warzone DMZ. This is very fun, I think. I can transform the weapon into anything I want. This is not available in other games. Apart from that, I can adjust things like recoil on the gun myself. Because there is less recoil, it is easier to control, which makes the game more fun. In DMZ, especially the movement mechanics of the character attract me very much. We don't just walk and run in the game, the character can slide and jump.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I play these games for fun and to pass the time with my friends. The awards for different modes in DMZ are also nice. I usually play for these, I have no end goal. I don't have a goal as there is no rank system.  As I said, I play to have fun and pass the time.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I always played the game for fun.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Having fun is always my goal, but sometimes I can focus on tasks. When there is any reward, the game becomes more valuable to me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: When there's a reward, it gets in the way of fun for me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I think the time spent doing nothing in the game is too much. The game draws me in. There are things I need to do. I'm constantly looting and wandering, there are always goals in the game, but the time spent on the goals can be boring sometimes.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: There are times when I take a break from playing because as I said, the game is constantly repeating itself. But there is nothing so glaring as to cause me to completely abandon the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Yes, the lack of variety offered by the game is the reason for this.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: First of all, it is a great advantage that DMZ has the weapon mechanics of the Call of Duty. I think that's the only advantage. Other than that, I can't see any advantage, the logic of all these games are the same.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: You are constantly in the game compared to tactical FPS games played round by round. When you die, you can immediately start over. It has a more detailed loot system compared to other games. I can't call them advantages, but these are differences. I do not see them as an advantage over other FPS games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Yes, I think, in games like this, you usually have to try very hard to understand the weapon mechanics. The time a good player and a bad player spend on the game is very different.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I think this is a different and good game loop. But I think the game should offer a difference, it can be boring when every raid is the same.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Yes, because as I said, this is a different mechanism, there is no such mechanism in other game genres.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Frankly, I don't think games like this have long-term goals because of the concept they offer.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: No, it was always the same.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: As I said before, my first goal was to have fun. Spending time with my friends, having fun, sharing something with my friends… These were my particular goals in PVPVE games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: This is not a long-term goal for me because the games you showed me don't have any rank system. I feel my own progress while playing, but I cannot see this progress because there is no rank system.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Yes, because you play on an open world map, you can do whatever you want, you can choose the tasks you want to do, and you can choose the places you want to go. This is not the case in other FPS games, the things you have to go and do are certain.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Yes it is for me. This is a factor that draws me to games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: The most important freedom for me is that the map is an open world map and I can go wherever I want. It is also a great advantage that I can choose the weapon I will play with and the attachments on the weapon.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I can say the same as what I said before, the weapon is the most important factor for me when choosing the game I will play. In order to spend time in a game, I need to like the weapons and movement mechanisms. Tarkov attracted me because it offered something very different from the games on the market. Something being difficult, isn't always a bad thing.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Yes, I definitely think like that, being in the game all the time draws me to the game. It is important for me that there is no such thing as waiting after death in the game, that there is always something to do. It is important to be constantly on alert in the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: The most appealing one is more imaginative and in-depth shooting experience.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: The game is a FPS game so the most important thing is the weapons, Weapons are what we are most interested in the game. It is very difficult to explain in detail, it is easier to see the development.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: We need weapons to be on the alert, weapons are always important when a problem arises.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Fantasy themes can be good if done well, but I like realistic games more.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Can you give examples of fantasy themes?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I might want to, depending on the fantasy elements.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I think it would be nice if there was nothing to spoil the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I might want to experience it, I think it will make a difference.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: The important thing for me is that the design of this fantasy element does not disturb the balance of power in the game, this fantasy element does not provide excessive power. Sorry I can't comment too much on it since we're talking in general.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: If I have to give an example from games, the loot system in Tarkov is very good, having adjustable weapons in the DMZ is very good. The detailed maps in Tarkov are very good. I like weapons in DMZ mode more than realistic guns. Of course I would like to experience the other, but this is the style I am used to.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: PVP system and rank system is important.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: In Warzone, the loot comes directly to you in a bag, but in Tarkov you need to find this loot. Tarkov is better and more realistic in this. Likewise, in Tarkov, it's more fun that the map is jumpable and climbable. You can't see where your friend is in Tarkov on the map, so it is possible to accidentally kill the friend, but this is not the case in Warzone, I think it is better in Warzone. That's all I can say in general.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Rank system, I think the rank system is the most important thing that connects players to play.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: If the goal is realism, I don't think it's appropriate to buy these kinds of things. Buying stuff spoils the realism of the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: In general, I think there should be no skin in the game, but it is very important how much the skin has changed the player's gameplay and the weapon. If it makes a big impact, I think it will break the dynamic of the game. But if it's just a color change with minor impacts, it might be. I think they are also important in making money.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Do the tasks that the game gives you.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Yes, that's possible, we can sell the items we can get from the map. I think this is a good thing.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Are you talking about the money earned in the game?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: As long as it doesn't spoil the trade in the game, it can be good. In order for this to be done nicely, certain limitations can be set.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Just as things that can be bought with real money cannot be obtained by trying for a long time. Money should be used to buy things that are available in a shorter time, rather than buying things that are not available.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: I think that's a good thing, I think the element of luck adds something nice to the game. Loot Boxes add something good to the game, but they should still be in a way that does not spoil the game. The most important thing is the balance of the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Yes, but this should be limited. Instead of being able to buy unlimited boxes, it should be possible to buy a certain amount of boxes per week, moth or year.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D4-英文原版
text: Yes, In general, these are not paid attention to in money-oriented games.
